description.describe_ch: 介紹奈米科技發展現況，以及奈米科技產品的創新及在生活中的應用。
description.describe_eh: Introducing the current status of nanotechnology and its application to daily life, as well as the development of nanomaterials and nano-products.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解生活中常聽聞的奈米名詞與產品

targets.describe_ch: 能理解奈米金與奈米銀之製作方法、呈色原理與應用
targets.describe_en: Be able to understand how nano-gold and nano-silver are prepared and why they are colored and what their applications are

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Grading policy:
  a. Attendance 30%
  b. Assignments 30%
  c. Group Report 10%
  d. Final Exam 30%
 
The final exam is given online at the end of the semester to refresh your memory about the important topics on nanotechnology.
The group report should be submitted two weeks after the nano-experiment taken in class.
 
The nano-experiment is normally chosen from one of the following:
1.        Lotus effec experiment, or
2.        Nanosilver synthesis, or
3.        Nanocopper sysnthesis, or
4.        Polaroid lens experiment, or
5.        3D printing, or
6.        Huge bubble blowing, or
7.        Photonic crystal (artificial opal) synthesis
 
評分政策：
a. 出席率 30%
b. 工作 30%
c.  集團報告 10%
d.  期末考試 30%
 
期末考在學期末於線上進行，為了刷新你對奈米技術重要主題的記憶。
小組報告應在課堂上進行奈米實驗兩週後提交。
 
奈米實驗通常選擇以下其中一種：
1.        蓮花效應實驗，或
2.        奈米銀實驗，或
3.        奈米銅實驗，或
4.        偏光鏡實驗，或
5.        3D列印實作，或
6.        吹大泡泡實驗，或
7.        光子晶體(人造蛋白石)實作
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂規則，習慣班級文化。
一、課堂禮儀
1.	多元化和包容性
課程活動都在同學間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間應尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、種族文化、社經背景、性別等。
2.	課堂行為
(1)	學生應準時出席上課；如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。
(2)	上課時請勿講話、閱讀其他刊物、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除積極參與分組討論外，應減少與旁邊同學對話。
(3)	當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。
二、課程交流及網路禮儀
1.	iLearn仍然是教室，必須遵守適當的課堂行為，尊重同學和老師。
2.	您應留出時間，積極參與iLearn線上學習活動，並完成所有交付之學習任務，來完成課程活動。
3.	每次線上討論區，不要強勢主導任何討論，要給其他同學參加討論的機會，以提高每個人的學習體驗。
(1)	每個人均要保持開放的態度，尊重少數意見，甚至您也可以表達不同的意見。
(2)	適當地提出您的想法，並避免使用粗俗或令人反感的語言。
(3)	依主題寫作，重點和簡短表達。
(4)	在發表評論之前先閱讀所有發表文章或評論，再撰寫，以防止重複評論或提出已經回答的問題。
(5)	撰寫評論文字，應審閱、再審閱後發送。
(6)	網路溝通的語言。請避免過度使用表情符號。
(7)	避免使用地方語或俚語，有可能會導致誤解。
(8)	與其他學生分享提示，勿取笑某人的閱讀聽寫能力。
(9)	考慮他人的隱私。在給出同學的電子郵件地址或其他信息之前，請先徵得許可。
(10)	不能發表不當訊息；不要將病毒警告、連鎖信、笑話等轉發給同學或教師。
三、學生責任
1.	每位學生於每學期開學前，到MyFCU個人資料表，確認自己在逢甲大學所留的個人基本資料，包含手機電話、通訊住址等聯絡資訊，以利授課教師、教學助理、或開課單位職員能與您聯繫。
(1)	確認您的逢甲大學o365電子郵件和NID是開通的，o365作為師生教學與學習溝通之共通工具。
(2)	與教師和班上的同學進行電子郵件、公告欄等交流時，要寫清楚資訊，保持禮貌。
(3)	您的電子郵件要署名，老師不會回覆“匿名”信件。
2.	您要詳讀及了解本課程的教學大綱要求，即時更新最新資訊，做好學習時間的管理。
3.	隨時檢查您的逢甲大學電子郵件和登錄iLearn 清楚本課程所發布之訊息。
4.	您應依老師的授課內容與教學方式，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助老師改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及學習活動的安排。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
**Page 2**

Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only take place when students and instructors maintain mutual respect and dignity. To ensure a favorable learning environment, everyone is expected to adhere to the following points, observe classroom rules, and become accustomed to the class culture.

**I. Classroom Etiquette**

**1. Diversity and Inclusiveness**

Course activities are conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students, where everyone should respect and appreciate the personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives of every student, such as different educational systems at home and abroad, diverse admission and learning cultures, ethnic cultures, socioeconomic backgrounds, and gender.

**2. Classroom Conduct**

(1) Students should attend class on time; if you cannot arrive on time for your scheduled class, please do not register for the course.

(2) During class, please do not talk, read other publications, sleep, or do other non-course-related work. Dialogue with neighboring students should be minimized, except during active group discussions.

(3) You should listen attentively when classmates are giving presentations or asking questions.

**II. Course Communication and Netiquette**

**1.** iLearn is still a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be observed, respecting classmates and the instructor.

**2.** You should set aside time to actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete all assigned learning tasks to fulfill course requirements.

**3.** In every online discussion forum, do not aggressively dominate any discussion; give other students an opportunity to participate to enhance everyone’s learning experience.

(1) Everyone should maintain an open mind, respect minority opinions, and you may even express differing opinions.

(2) Present your ideas appropriately and avoid using vulgar or offensive language.

(3) Write according to the topic, focusing on key points and brief expression.

(4) Before posting a comment, read all previously posted articles or comments, and then write your own, to prevent duplicate comments or asking questions that have already been answered.

(5) Review and re-review your written comments before sending them.

(6) Language of online communication. Please avoid excessive use of emoticons.

(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang, as they may lead to misunderstanding.

(8) Share tips with other students; do not mock someone's reading or writing ability.

(9) Consider the privacy of others. Obtain permission before giving out a classmate’s email address or other information.

(10) Do not post inappropriate messages; do not forward virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or the instructor.

**III. Student Responsibilities**

**1.** Before the start of each semester, every student should go to the MyFCU Personal Data Form to confirm their basic personal information registered with Feng Chia University, including contact information such as mobile phone number and mailing address, to facilitate contact by the instructor, teaching assistant, or course administrative staff.

(1) Confirm that your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are activated. o365 serves as a common tool for teaching and learning communication between instructors and students.

(2) When communicating with the instructor and classmates via email, announcement boards, etc., write clearly and maintain politeness.

(3) Your email must be signed; the instructor will not reply to "anonymous" letters.

**2.** You must thoroughly read and understand the requirements of this course syllabus, promptly update the latest information, and manage your study time well.

**3.** Check your Feng Chia University email and log in to iLearn regularly to be clear about the messages published for this course.

**4.** You should provide mid-term and end-of-term course feedback regarding the instructor's teaching content and methods for this subject. Your participation and feedback will help the instructor improve teaching skills, course content, and the arrangement of learning activities. The mid-term formative teaching evaluation form is to be completed during weeks 4–8; the end-of-term student opinion survey and the end-of-term course objective learning achievement status are to be completed in the last month of the semester.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。

  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。

3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。

  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。

以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity
 
1. Integrity is a fundamental attitude and a declaration of professional values, a principle of conduct that translates academic ideals into action, and the realization of social responsibility.
 
2. One of the most important values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
  • Students should value and strictly adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance should not be given, used, or accepted in academic activities. This includes the use of library collections, copyrighted teaching materials, readings, and audio-visual resources.
  • Uphold integrity, actively attend, and participate in classroom learning commitments.
  • Students should respect everyone in the classroom and act responsibly and courteously at all times.
3. Students have the responsibility to complete their learning tasks and avoid all forms of academic dishonesty.
  • No Cheating: During paper-and-pencil examinations, talking, peeking at others' test papers, intentionally facilitating neighbors to peek, or being caught bringing, copying, or passing materials will result in a zero grade for that exam. Depending on the severity of the violation, or in cases of substitution, both parties involved in the cheating incident will be dealt with according to the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University's Student Examination Regulations and Student Disciplinary Measures.
  • No Plagiarism: Submit original work and strictly prohibit any form of plagiarism.
  • No Falsification: Tampering with grades or other official documents, such as clinic medical certificates.
  • No Tampering/No Fabrication: The artificial creation of data or the invention of non-existent data or sources during the process of collecting data from experiments is considered fabrication or tampering.
  • No Destruction: Damaging others' artwork, experiments, or design results is considered an act of destruction. Failing to contribute to a team project is also considered academic destruction.
Violations of the above situations will be referred for disciplinary action in accordance with the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University's Student Disciplinary Measures, etc., depending on the severity of the violation.

integrity.course_pol_en:
**Page 2**

Classroom behavior should always be timely, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only take place when students and instructors maintain mutual respect and dignity. To ensure a favorable learning environment, everyone is expected to adhere to the following points, observe classroom rules, and become accustomed to the class culture.

**I. Classroom Etiquette**

**1. Diversity and Inclusiveness**

Course activities are conducted in a friendly and interactive atmosphere among students, where everyone should respect and appreciate the personal experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives of every student, such as different educational systems at home and abroad, diverse admission and learning cultures, ethnic cultures, socioeconomic backgrounds, and gender.

**2. Classroom Conduct**

(1) Students should attend class on time; if you cannot arrive on time for your scheduled class, please do not register for the course.

(2) During class, please do not talk, read other publications, sleep, or do other non-course-related work. Dialogue with neighboring students should be minimized, except during active group discussions.

(3) You should listen attentively when classmates are giving presentations or asking questions.

**II. Course Communication and Netiquette**

**1.** iLearn is still a classroom, and appropriate classroom behavior must be observed, respecting classmates and the instructor.

**2.** You should set aside time to actively participate in iLearn online learning activities and complete all assigned learning tasks to fulfill course requirements.

**3.** In every online discussion forum, do not aggressively dominate any discussion; give other students an opportunity to participate to enhance everyone’s learning experience.

(1) Everyone should maintain an open mind, respect minority opinions, and you may even express differing opinions.

(2) Present your ideas appropriately and avoid using vulgar or offensive language.

(3) Write according to the topic, focusing on key points and brief expression.

(4) Before posting a comment, read all previously posted articles or comments, and then write your own, to prevent duplicate comments or asking questions that have already been answered.

(5) Review and re-review your written comments before sending them.

(6) Language of online communication. Please avoid excessive use of emoticons.

(7) Avoid using regional dialects or slang, as they may lead to misunderstanding.

(8) Share tips with other students; do not mock someone's reading or writing ability.

(9) Consider the privacy of others. Obtain permission before giving out a classmate’s email address or other information.

(10) Do not post inappropriate messages; do not forward virus warnings, chain letters, jokes, etc., to classmates or the instructor.

**III. Student Responsibilities**

**1.** Before the start of each semester, every student should go to the MyFCU Personal Data Form to confirm their basic personal information registered with Feng Chia University, including contact information such as mobile phone number and mailing address, to facilitate contact by the instructor, teaching assistant, or course administrative staff.

(1) Confirm that your Feng Chia University o365 email and NID are activated. o365 serves as a common tool for teaching and learning communication between instructors and students.

(2) When communicating with the instructor and classmates via email, announcement boards, etc., write clearly and maintain politeness.

(3) Your email must be signed; the instructor will not reply to "anonymous" letters.

**2.** You must thoroughly read and understand the requirements of this course syllabus, promptly update the latest information, and manage your study time well.

**3.** Check your Feng Chia University email and log in to iLearn regularly to be clear about the messages published for this course.

**4.** You should provide mid-term and end-of-term course feedback regarding the instructor's teaching content and methods for this subject. Your participation and feedback will help the instructor improve teaching skills, course content, and the arrangement of learning activities. The mid-term formative teaching evaluation form is to be completed during weeks 4–8; the end-of-term student opinion survey and the end-of-term course objective learning achievement status are to be completed in the last month of the semester.

integrity.ais_meno:
1.    誠信是基本的態度與專業價值的宣言，是將學術理想轉化為行動的行為原則以及落實社會責任。
2.    學術誠信最重要的價值觀之一是思想自由流動與尊重他人智慧財產權之間的平衡。

  • 學生應重視及恪遵智慧財產權。不得在學術活動中給予、使用或接受未經授權的援助。使用圖書館館藏、有版權的教材讀本與影音資料。
  • 恪守誠信，積極出席和參與課堂的學習承諾。
  • 學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以負責和禮貌的態度行事。

3.    學生有責任做好自己的學習任務，並避免一切形式的學術不誠實行為。

  • 不作弊：紙筆測驗時，不得交談、窺竊他人試卷或故意便利鄰座竊窺，或有夾帶、抄襲或傳遞資料等情事經發現時，違者該次考試成績以零分計算。並視違者情節，或有替考情事，其舞弊之雙方，將依逢甲大學學生考試辦法、學生獎懲辦法之相關規定處理。
  • 不抄襲：提交原創作品，嚴禁任何形式的抄襲。
  • 不偽造：篡改成績或其他正式文件，如診所就醫證明。
  • 不篡改/不捏造：從實驗中蒐集數據過程，以人為方式創建數據或編造不存在的數據或資料來源，均被視為捏造或篡改
  • 不破壞：破壞他人的藝術品、實驗或設計成果被視為破壞行為。未能為團隊專題做出貢獻，也被視為學術破壞。

以上情況視違者情節，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法等相關規定提送處分。
integrity.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity
 
1. Integrity is a fundamental attitude and a declaration of professional values, a principle of conduct that translates academic ideals into action, and the realization of social responsibility.
 
2. One of the most important values of academic integrity is the balance between the free flow of ideas and respect for the intellectual property rights of others.
  • Students should value and strictly adhere to intellectual property rights. Unauthorized assistance should not be given, used, or accepted in academic activities. This includes the use of library collections, copyrighted teaching materials, readings, and audio-visual resources.
  • Uphold integrity, actively attend, and participate in classroom learning commitments.
  • Students should respect everyone in the classroom and act responsibly and courteously at all times.
3. Students have the responsibility to complete their learning tasks and avoid all forms of academic dishonesty.
  • No Cheating: During paper-and-pencil examinations, talking, peeking at others' test papers, intentionally facilitating neighbors to peek, or being caught bringing, copying, or passing materials will result in a zero grade for that exam. Depending on the severity of the violation, or in cases of substitution, both parties involved in the cheating incident will be dealt with according to the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University's Student Examination Regulations and Student Disciplinary Measures.
  • No Plagiarism: Submit original work and strictly prohibit any form of plagiarism.
  • No Falsification: Tampering with grades or other official documents, such as clinic medical certificates.
  • No Tampering/No Fabrication: The artificial creation of data or the invention of non-existent data or sources during the process of collecting data from experiments is considered fabrication or tampering.
  • No Destruction: Damaging others' artwork, experiments, or design results is considered an act of destruction. Failing to contribute to a team project is also considered academic destruction.
Violations of the above situations will be referred for disciplinary action in accordance with the relevant regulations of Feng Chia University's Student Disciplinary Measures, etc., depending on the severity of the violation.
